g.text: Nothing the model says reaches the user without passing code
Trust layer 1/2: grades and hidden answers.
The model says
Code checks it before anyone sees it
Each answer comes with quotes
and the field id they came from
A quote must appear in the field it cites.
Found in another field: kept, the citation is corrected.
Found nowhere: dropped.
Status: answered or partial
No quote survived → missing, flagged unverified.
An answer without proof doesn't count.
Status: contradicted
Needs verified quotes from 2 different fields
(title says 6 pens, description says 3).
Only one side proven → answered, flagged.
Status: not applicable
Allowed only for conditional questions (erasable, scent).
Anything else → missing. The model can't dodge a question.
Vision: claims printed in images,
and whether the text covers each
A hidden answer needs 2 signals to agree: the verified text
grade is missing or partial AND an image claim answers
that question. “In text” needs a verified quote.
